params.name: filter[groups]
params.description: Filtered tag keys that the metric is configured to query with.

params.name: filter[hours_ago]
params.description: The number of hours of look back (from now) to estimate cardinality with. If unspecified, it defaults to 0 hours.

params.name: filter[num_aggregations]
params.description: Deprecated. Number of aggregations has no impact on volume.

params.name: filter[pct]
params.description: A boolean, for distribution metrics only, to estimate cardinality if the metric includes additional percentile aggregators.

params.name: filter[timespan_h]
params.description: A window, in hours, from the look back to estimate cardinality with. The minimum and default is 1 hour.

items.docs: Returns the estimated cardinality for a metric with a given tag, percentile and number of aggregations configuration using Metrics without Limits™.
